text: Marqeta priced its IPO on June 8, 2021 at $108 a share, split-adjusted, and closed its first day at $122.08. The stock peaked at $133.00 on November 1, 2021, fell to a low of $13.68 on November 5, 2024, and closed the five years at $15.56 on June 16, 2026, 85.6% below the offer price, all split-adjusted. Its filings show fast revenue growth stalling after its largest customer renewed at lower pricing, then a weaker outlook and leadership changes.
